steps.en: Notices whose agency particulars update failed are flagged as errors
steps.id: Notice yang update particulars-nya gagal dari agency ditandai error
steps.why_en: No court application batch exists, so no batch-level error detection runs.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada batch court application, jadi tidak ada deteksi error per batch.

steps.en: Error reason is recorded for each failed notice
steps.id: Alasan error dicatat untuk tiap notice yang gagal
steps.why_en: No place to store a court batch error list or its reasons was found.
steps.why_id: Tidak ditemukan tempat menyimpan daftar error batch court beserta alasannya.

steps.en: A work item with the error notices and reasons is created
steps.id: Work item berisi error notice dan alasannya dibuat
steps.why_en: Work item creation is only a placeholder that writes a log line and is for another flow.
steps.why_id: Pembuatan work item hanya placeholder yang menulis log dan untuk alur lain.

steps.en: The work item appears on the OIC's dashboard
steps.id: Work item muncul di dashboard OIC
steps.why_en: The staff dashboard is an empty page with no work item list.
steps.why_id: Dashboard staff berupa halaman kosong tanpa daftar work item.

steps.en: The OIC reviews and decides to proceed or reject
steps.id: OIC mereview dan memutuskan lanjut atau tolak
steps.why_en: No review screen or decision action for court batch notices exists.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada layar review atau aksi keputusan untuk notice batch court.
